questions.title: Walk me through your background
questions.prompt: Walk me through your background and what brings you to this role.
hints: Keep it to about 90 seconds.
End with why this role is the next step.

questions.title: A project you are proud of
questions.prompt: Tell me about a project you are proud of. What did you personally contribute, and what was the result?
hints: Use Situation, Task, Action, Result.
Separate your work from the team's work.

questions.title: Disagreement with a teammate
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it, and what was the outcome?
hints: Explain the shared goal without assigning blame.

questions.title: A time you failed
questions.prompt: Describe a time you failed or made a mistake. How did you respond, and what did you change afterward?
hints: Pick a real example and own your part.
Spend most of the time on what you learned.

questions.title: Working under a deadline
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you had to deliver under a tight deadline. How did you prioritize?
hints: Name what you chose not to do, and why.

questions.title: Leading without authority
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you led a group or influenced others without formal authority.
hints: Show how you got buy-in.

questions.title: Acting on difficult feedback
questions.prompt: Describe a time you received difficult feedback. What did you do with it?
hints: Show a concrete change in behavior.

questions.title: Handling ambiguity
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you had to make progress with unclear goals or incomplete information.
hints: Explain how you reduced the uncertainty.

questions.title: Going beyond the ask
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you took initiative on something nobody asked you to do.
hints: Explain why it mattered and what changed because of it.

questions.title: Why this field
questions.prompt: Why do you want to work in this field, and what will make you successful in it?
